name: Rotationally Invariant Gaussian Splatting
definition: A splatting technique using a Gaussian weighting function to achieve rotational symmetry, avoiding the need for separate integration for each new orientation in perspective projection.
summary: Rotationally Invariant Gaussian Splatting is a volume rendering technique using a Gaussian weighting function to achieve rotational symmetry and a closed-form analytic solution for 2D projection, avoiding separate integration for each orientation.
